label: final retained content and engine census

arguments.code: local w=workspace.NightShiftWorld; local out={PlaceId=game.PlaceId,Name=game.Name,Baseplate=workspace:FindFirstChild('Baseplate')~=nil,OriginalSpawn=workspace:FindFirstChild('SpawnLocation')~=nil,Streaming=workspace.StreamingEnabled,MaxPlayers=game:GetService('Players').MaxPlayers,ClockTime=game:GetService('Lighting').ClockTime,Parts=0,Lights=0,Stores={},Sources={}}; for _,v in ipairs(w:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA('BasePart') then out.Parts+=1 elseif v:IsA('Light') then out.Lights+=1 end end; for _,s in ipairs(w.Stores:GetChildren()) do table.insert(out.Stores,s.Name) end; for _,service in ipairs({game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'),game:GetService('ServerStorage'),game:GetService('ServerScriptService'),game:GetService('StarterPlayer')}) do for _,v in ipairs(service:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') and v:GetAttribute('NightShiftOwned') then table.insert(out.Sources,{Path=v:GetFullName(),Class=v.ClassName,Hash=v:GetAttribute('NightShiftSourceHash')}) end end end return game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONEncode(out)
